# Rohit Kushwaha

> Rohit Kushwaha is an AI engineer and full-stack developer from Ambernath, Maharashtra, India. He builds AI agents, generative UI and developer tools end to end across Svelte, React, Next.js, Astro, Python, and Node.js, contributes to open-source AI-agent platforms, and creates developer tools such as discli and Lito.

## Location and contact

- Based in Ambernath, Thane district, Maharashtra, India (Mumbai Metropolitan Region), close to Badlapur, Ulhasnagar, Kalyan and Dombivli.
- Open to freelance AI and full-stack work, remotely.
- Email: rohitk290106@gmail.com
